text_en: While Paul was looking intently at the council he said, “Brothers, up to this day I have lived my life with a clear conscience before God. ”
text_cn: 保禄注视着公议会说：“诸位仁人弟兄！我在天主前，作事为人，全凭纯善的良心，直到今天。”

text_en: Then the high priest Ananias ordered those standing near him to strike him on the mouth.
text_cn: 大司祭阿纳尼雅却命站在旁边的人打他的嘴。

text_en: At this Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Are you sitting there to judge me according to the law, and yet in violation of the law you order me to be struck? ”
text_cn: 那时，保禄向他说：“粉白的墙啊！天主将要打击你；你坐下审判我，应按照法律，你竟违反法律，下令打我吗？”

text_en: Those standing nearby said, “Do you dare to insult God’s high priest? ”
text_cn: 旁边站着的人说：“你竟敢辱骂天主的大司祭吗？”

text_en: And Paul said, “I did not realize, brothers, that he was high priest; for it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a leader of your people. ’”
text_cn: 保禄说：“弟兄们！我原不知道他是大司祭，因为经上记载说：‘不可诅咒你百姓的首长。’”

text_en: When Paul noticed that some were Sadducees and others were Pharisees, he called out in the council, “Brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. I am on trial concerning the hope of the resurrection of the dead. ”
text_cn: 保禄一看出他们一部份是撒杜塞人，另一部份是法利塞人，就在公议会中喊说：“诸位仁人弟兄！我是法利塞人，是法利塞人的儿子，我是为了希望死者的复活，现在受审。”

text_en: When he said this, a dissension began between the Pharisees and the Sadducees, and the assembly was divided.
text_cn: 他说了这话，法利塞人和撒杜塞人便起了争辩，会众就分裂了。

text_en: (The Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, or angel, or spirit; but the Pharisees acknowledge all three. )
text_cn: 原来撒杜塞人说没有复活，也没有天使，也没有神灵；法利塞人却样样都承认。

text_en: Then a great clamor arose, and certain scribes of the Pharisees’ group stood up and contended, “We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him? ”
text_cn: 于是喧嚷大起，有几个法利塞党的经师起来力争说：“我们在这人身上找不出一点过错来；或者有神灵或天使同他说了话！”

text_en: When the dissension became violent, the tribune, fearing that they would tear Paul to pieces, ordered the soldiers to go down, take him by force, and bring him into the barracks.
text_cn: 争辩越来越大，千夫长怕保禄被他们撕裂，便命军队下来，把保禄从他们中间抢出来，带到营里去了。

text_en: That night the Lord stood near him and said, “Keep up your courage! For just as you have testified for me in Jerusalem, so you must bear witness also in Rome. ”
text_cn: 次夜，主显现给保禄说：“你放心罢！你怎样在耶路撒冷为我作证，也该怎样在罗马为我作证。”

text_en: In the morning the Jews joined in a conspiracy and bound themselves by an oath neither to eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.
text_cn: 天一亮，犹太人共商阴谋，发自诅的誓说：“不杀了保禄，决不吃不喝。”

text_en: There were more than forty who joined in this conspiracy.
text_cn: 发这誓的有四十多人；

text_en: They went to the chief priests and elders and said, “We have strictly bound ourselves by an oath to taste no food until we have killed Paul.
text_cn: 这些人来到司祭长及长老前说：“我们发了自诅的誓，不杀了保禄，什么也不吃。

text_en: Now then, you and the council must notify the tribune to bring him down to you, on the pretext that you want to make a more thorough examination of his case. And we are ready to do away with him before he arrives. ”
text_cn: 所以，你们同公议会现在要通知千夫长，带保禄下到你们这里，你们假装要更详细审讯他的事；我们早准备好，在他来到你们这里以前，就杀掉他。”

text_en: Now the son of Paul’s sister heard about the ambush; so he went and gained entrance to the barracks and told Paul.
text_cn: 可是，保禄姊妹的儿子，听到了这种诡计，就来到营里，报告给保禄。

text_en: Paul called one of the centurions and said, “Take this young man to the tribune, for he has something to report to him. ”
text_cn: 保禄就叫来一个百夫长说：“请领这个青年到千夫长那里去，他有事要向他报告。”

text_en: So he took him, brought him to the tribune, and said, “The prisoner Paul called me and asked me to bring this young man to you; he has something to tell you. ”
text_cn: 于是百夫长就带他到千夫长那里说：“囚犯保禄叫我去，求我把这个青年领到你这里来，他有事要告诉你。”

text_en: The tribune took him by the hand, drew him aside privately, and asked, “What is it that you have to report to me? ”
text_cn: 千夫长拉着他的手，走到一边，私下询问说：“你有什么事要向我报告？”

text_en: He answered, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though they were going to inquire more thoroughly into his case.
text_cn: 他说：“犹太人已约定请求你，明天把保禄带下去，到公议会里，假装要更详细查问他的事。

text_en: But do not be persuaded by them, for more than forty of their men are lying in ambush for him. They have bound themselves by an oath neither to eat nor drink until they kill him. They are ready now and are waiting for your consent. ”
text_cn: 所以你切不要听从他们，因为他们中有四十多人埋伏着等待保禄，这些人已发了自诅的誓，非杀掉他，决不吃不喝；现在他们已准备好，只等候你的应允。”

text_en: So the tribune dismissed the young man, ordering him, “Tell no one that you have informed me of this. ”
text_cn: 于是千夫长便打发那青年走了，并吩咐他说：“不要向任何人说你将这事报告给我了。”

text_en: Then he summoned two of the centurions and said, “Get ready to leave by nine o’clock tonight for Caesarea with two hundred soldiers, seventy horsemen, and two hundred spearmen.
text_cn: 千夫长遂叫来了两个百夫长说：“预备二百士兵，七十骑兵，二百长枪手，今夜第三时辰，往凯撒勒雅去，

text_en: Also provide mounts for Paul to ride, and take him safely to Felix the governor. ”
text_cn: 并备妥牲口，叫保禄骑上，把他平安护送到斐理斯总督那里。”

text_en: He wrote a letter to this effect:
text_cn: 他写了一封这样的信：

text_en: “Claudius Lysias to his Excellency the governor Felix, greetings.
text_cn: “喀劳狄里息雅向总督斐理斯钧座请安。

text_en: This man was seized by the Jews and was about to be killed by them, but when I had learned that he was a Roman citizen, I came with the guard and rescued him.
text_cn: 这人为犹太人拿住，快要被他们杀掉时，我听说他是罗马人，就带军队到场，把他救出。

text_en: Since I wanted to know the charge for which they accused him, I had him brought to their council.
text_cn: 我想要知道他们所以控告他的缘由，就带他下到他们的公议会去。

text_en: I found that he was accused concerning questions of their law, but was charged with nothing deserving death or imprisonment.
text_cn: 得知他被控告，是为了他们的法律问题，并没有任何该死或该监禁的罪行。

text_en: When I was informed that there would be a plot against the man, I sent him to you at once, ordering his accusers also to state before you what they have against him. ”
text_cn: 有人告知我，将有阴谋陷害他。我便立刻打发他到你这里来，并吩咐原告到你面前控诉他。祝你安好！”

text_en: So the soldiers, according to their instructions, took Paul and brought him during the night to Antipatris.
text_cn: 于是士兵照所命令的，夜间带领保禄到了安提帕特；

text_en: The next day they let the horsemen go on with him, while they returned to the barracks.
text_cn: 第二天，让骑兵跟保禄同去，别的就回到营里。

text_en: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they presented Paul also before him.
text_cn: 他们进了凯撒勒雅，把信呈给总督，并引保禄到他面前。

text_en: On reading the letter, he asked what province he belonged to, and when he learned that he was from Cilicia,
text_cn: 总督读了信，便问保禄是那一省的人；既查知他是基里基雅人，

text_en: he said, “I will give you a hearing when your accusers arrive. ” Then he ordered that he be kept under guard in Herod’s headquarters.
text_cn: 便说：“等控告你的人来到，我再听审你。”遂下令把保禄看守在黑落德王府里。
